issue_title: Performance regression: LCP spiked site-wide, all pages now below 85
issue_body:
## Performance Regression — 2026-10-13

All five audited pages have dropped significantly below the 85 performance threshold since the previous audit (2026-10-12), driven primarily by LCP spikes that appear to have occurred overnight.

### Score summary

| Page | Prev | Now | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 87 | 62 | **−25** |
| `/about` | 90 | 71 | **−19** |
| `/projects` | 90 | 78 | **−12** |
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 82 | 71 | **−11** |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 80 | 58 | **−22** |

### LCP summary

| Page | Prev LCP | Now LCP | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 3,739 ms | 7,133 ms | **+3,394 ms** |
| `/about` | 3,339 ms | 5,482 ms | **+2,143 ms** |
| `/projects` | 3,348 ms | 4,535 ms | **+1,187 ms** |
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 4,038 ms | 5,843 ms | **+1,805 ms** |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 4,361 ms | 7,759 ms | **+3,398 ms** |

### Likely causes
- CDN cache miss or origin response time degradation affecting image/asset delivery
- LCP hero images are not preloaded with `fetchpriority="high"`

### Recommended fixes (in priority order)
1. **Check CDN/hosting health** — the uniform site-wide LCP spike suggests a infrastructure-level issue (cache invalidation, origin slowdown, or cold-start latency)
2. **Add `<link rel="preload" as="image" fetchpriority="high">` for LCP images** on `/`, `/about`, and `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` — these have the worst LCP values
3. **Serve images in next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF)** and ensure correct `Cache-Control` headers are set

### Visual status
All pages are visually intact — no layout breakage, overflow, or missing sections on desktop or mobile. Accessibility, best-practices, and SEO remain at 100 across all pages.
